Android 17 QPR1 is officially here, and it’s packed with over 300 security fixes and critical performance optimizations for your Pixel device. In this deep dive, we break down the September 2026 update, covering everything from game-changing graphics stability to essential connectivity improvements and UI polish. 

Whether you're rocking a Pixel 6 or the latest 10a, this update is crucial for keeping your device running smooth, snappy, and secure.
